artists.source_line: Jazzy Cubango and Fred Maestro are proud to announce the 14TH PARIS KIZOMBA CONGRESS. ★★★ THE BIGGEST KIZOMBA

features.rationale: The description states that more than 40 hours of workshops are part of the congress.
A pre-party is explicitly listed alongside the main parties.
The weekend includes three parties with a theme.
A separate social room is listed in addition to the main dancefloor, so there is more than one dance room.
